promptsAndSamples.title: Advertising effectiveness and consumer attention
promptsAndSamples.questionType: Discuss both views and give your opinion
promptsAndSamples.prompt: Some people believe advertising strongly influences what we buy. Others think that advertising is so widespread that people no longer notice it. Discuss both views and give your own opinion. Write at least 250 words.
promptsAndSamples.sampleEssay:
Advertising is a powerful part of modern commerce, but its influence is not uniform. Some campaigns change purchasing habits by making a product memorable, whereas constant exposure can make other advertisements almost invisible. In my view, advertising remains effective when it is relevant and credible, but repetition alone soon loses its impact.

Well-designed advertising can persuade consumers in several ways. A clear demonstration may show how a product solves a genuine problem, while a story can associate it with a desirable lifestyle. Useful comparisons, transparent evidence, and carefully chosen audiences can make a campaign feel informative rather than intrusive. This kind of message gives people a reason to consider a purchase instead of merely demanding attention. Repeated but moderate exposure also helps people remember a brand when they eventually need a particular service. For example, a local repair company that explains its prices and displays independent reviews may attract customers who value reliability rather than novelty and short-term excitement.

However, the sheer volume of advertising can produce indifference. People routinely skip online adverts, mute television commercials, or ignore banners while concentrating on another task. When every message uses exaggerated claims, consumers may also become sceptical and rely on recommendations instead. This is especially true for audiences who have seen the same campaign many times without finding it useful.

Overall, advertising still shapes consumer decisions, but saturation limits its power. Campaigns that offer relevant information and respect the audience are more likely to succeed than those that simply repeat a slogan.

examinerFeedback.taskResponse: The response discusses both perspectives and maintains a clear position, with relevant examples and a developed conclusion.
examinerFeedback.coherenceAndCohesion: The ideas progress from the persuasive role of advertising to the effects of saturation, with clear paragraphing and linking.
examinerFeedback.lexicalResource: The response uses a varied range of topic vocabulary, including consumer decisions, independent reviews, and audience saturation.
examinerFeedback.grammaticalRangeAndAccuracy: A range of sentence structures is used accurately, including concession, condition, and relative clauses.

promptsAndSamples.title: Artificial Intelligence and Employment
promptsAndSamples.prompt: In recent years, artificial intelligence and automation technologies have developed rapidly and are replacing human labor in various sectors. Do the advantages of this development outweigh the disadvantages? Write at least 250 words.
promptsAndSamples.sampleEssay:
The swift rise of artificial intelligence and automated systems is reshaping the modern labor landscape. While some critics argue that automation exacerbates unemployment and widens socio-economic disparities, I firmly believe that the long-term benefits in terms of productivity, safety, and innovation significantly outweigh the immediate drawbacks.

On the one hand, technological displacement undeniably creates short-term friction in the workforce. Routine manual tasks and administrative roles are increasingly delegated to intelligent algorithms, which can lead to redundancy among low-skilled laborers who may struggle to transition into technical industries. Furthermore, the rapid pace of digital transformation can leave educational systems lagging behind, resulting in structural unemployment. Consequently, governments must invest substantially in retraining programs to mitigate these societal shocks.

On the other hand, the advantages of artificial intelligence are transformative. Firstly, AI dramatically enhances operational efficiency and eradicates human error in high-precision domains, such as surgical medicine, aeronautics, and manufacturing. By delegating hazardous and repetitive duties to automated systems, human workers are shielded from workplace hazards. Secondly, historical precedents illustrate that technological revolutions inevitably generate entirely new industries and professions that were previously unimaginable, such as data engineering, cyber security, and machine learning oversight. Ultimately, this shifts human employment toward creative problem-solving and interpersonal roles.

In conclusion, although the automation wave introduces legitimate challenges regarding job transition and skill retraining, its capacity to elevate overall human living standards and drive economic innovation ensures that its advantages are far more substantial than its negative impacts.

examinerFeedback.taskResponse: Comprehensive answer with a fully developed argument, clearly stated stance, and rigorous supporting rationale throughout.
examinerFeedback.coherenceAndCohesion: Exemplary paragraphing, natural and varied cohesive links (On the one hand, Furthermore, Consequently, On the other hand, Firstly, Secondly, In conclusion).
examinerFeedback.lexicalResource: Sophisticated academic register with accurate collocations (technological displacement, socio-economic disparities, structural unemployment, operational efficiency, historical precedents).
examinerFeedback.grammaticalRangeAndAccuracy: Wide flexibility of complex syntax, subordinate clauses, passive voice, and flawless punctuation.

promptsAndSamples.title: Renewable Energy Production by Source (2010-2025)
promptsAndSamples.prompt: The graph below shows the amount of electricity generated from four renewable energy sources (Solar, Wind, Hydroelectric, and Biomass) in a European nation between 2010 and 2025. Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant. Write at least 150 words.
promptsAndSamples.sampleEssay:
The line graph illustrates the quantity of electricity produced by four distinct renewable energy sources—Solar, Wind, Hydroelectric, and Biomass—in a particular European country over a fifteen-year timeframe spanning from 2010 to 2025, measured in terawatt-hours (TWh).

Overall, it is evident that total renewable energy output experienced an upward trajectory across the entire period. While hydroelectric power remained the dominant energy producer throughout most of the period, solar energy exhibited the most exponential growth, nearly matching hydro by the end of the projection.

In 2010, hydroelectric generation was by far the highest contributor at approximately 80 TWh, followed distantly by wind at 35 TWh, biomass at 20 TWh, and solar at a negligible 5 TWh. Hydroelectric power fluctuated marginally over the following years before plateauing around 90 TWh by 2025.

In stark contrast, solar power underwent a dramatic surge, especially after 2018, climbing steeply to reach 85 TWh in 2025. Wind energy also registered steady progress, rising to 60 TWh by the terminal year. Conversely, biomass witnessed modest, linear gains, concluding at just under 30 TWh in 2025.

examinerFeedback.taskAchievement: Presents a clear, well-developed overview identifying key trends and accurate data comparisons without unnecessary listing.
examinerFeedback.coherenceAndCohesion: Information is logically grouped into an overview paragraph and two detailed comparison paragraphs with seamless linking phrases.
examinerFeedback.lexicalResource: Rich graphical description vocabulary (upward trajectory, dominant energy producer, exponential growth, plateauing, stark contrast, surge, linear gains).
examinerFeedback.grammaticalRangeAndAccuracy: Varied complex structures and participle clauses with complete grammatical precision.
